title: SSC CGL Tier-1 Full Mock Test 04 (Hard Level)
description: Hard Level Full Length Mock Test for SSC CGL Tier-1. 100 Questions | 60 Minutes | Reasoning 25, GA 25, Quant 25, English 25.
instructions: Yeh Hard Level Full Length Mock Test hai.
Total 100 questions: Reasoning 25, General Awareness 25, Quantitative Aptitude 25, English 25.
Har question 2 marks ka hai. Galat jawab par 0.5 marks katenge.
SSC CGL Tier-1 latest pattern ke anusar.
